Penjenayah dan Orang-orang Yang Tidak Di ingini (Pindaan) (No. 2) kuasa.
1976 dan hendaklah mula berkuatkuasa pada 1hb Oktober 1976.

2. Bahagian IV kepada Jadual Pertama (Sabah), Bahagian IV kepada Pindaan
Jadual Pertama (Sarawak) dan Bahagian VI kepada Jadual Pertama Jadual
(Negeri-negeri Tanah Melayu) kepada Akta Pendaftaran Penjenayah Pom.
dan Orang-orang Yang Tidak Di ingini 1969 adalah dipinda dengan
menambah kepadanya kesalahan-kesalahan yang tersebut di dalam
Jadual di bawah ini.

REGISTRATION OF CRIMINALS AND UNDESIRABLE
PERSONS ACT 1969

REGISTRATION OF CRIMINALS AND UNDESIRABLE PERSONS
(AMENDMENT) (No. 2) ORDER 1976

In exercise of the powers conferred by subsection (1) of section 15 of

the Registration of Criminals and Undesirable Persons Act 1969, the Ace7.
Minister makes the following order:

1. This Order may be cited as the Registration of Criminals and Un- Citation and
desirable Persons (Amendment) (No. 2) Order 1976 and shall come into teat"
force on Ist October 1976.

2. Part IV of the First Schedule (Sabah), Part IV of the First Schedule Amendment
(Sarawak) and Part VI of the First Schedule (States of Malaya} to the Schedule.
Registration of Criminals and Undesirable Persons Act 1969, are

amended by adding thereto the offences specified in the Schedule hereto.
